candidate.perspective: Nigerian businesses, rural service providers, public schools, clinics and wholesale telecom access buyers currently constrained by costly or missing backhaul connectivity.
candidate.structural_condition: Nigeria's last-mile and wholesale backbone access remains constrained; the BRIDGE public-private open-access fibre initiative has multilateral financing approval but has not demonstrated nationwide commissioned service.
candidate.delta: The World Bank Group's 11 October 2026 FY2026 private-capital mobilisation update specified an expected initial BRIDGE investor-selection round of at least US$156 million private equity and potential later mobilisation of up to US$1.1 billion by 2030. This advances financing visibility relative to the October 2025 approval but is not an equity close, commissioned fibre or observed user connectivity.
candidate.mechanism: A majority privately owned open-access backbone could eventually lower wholesale connectivity barriers for multiple service providers, enabling digital services and productivity in underserved areas; execution depends on procurement, right-of-way, financing close, network operation and commercially viable last-mile access.
catalysts: Publication of first-round investor selection and actual equity closing
Verified SPV formation, signed contracts and kilometres commissioned
Independent wholesale tariffs, reliability, access and uptake data
candidate.invalidation: Private equity selection fails or is delayed, rights-of-way and power costs prevent network delivery, open-access terms are noncompetitive, or measured connectivity fails to expand despite completed backbone.

evidence.name: World Bank — FY2026 Nigeria private-capital mobilisation and BRIDGE progress
World Bank — 2025 BRIDGE financing approval and design
AfDB — BRIDGE fibre backbone financing approval

candidate.notes: This is a staged implementation/financing hypothesis, not proof of 90,000 km constructed, 58 million newly connected, $156m equity raised or $1.1bn private capital disbursed.
